# Phase 2: Constructing Materials Project REST API Calls

Materials Project calls are executed against the REST API via envelope entries formatted as `{module, function, kwargs}`.

## 1. Envelope Structure

- `"module"`: Always `"mp_api"`
- `"function"`: The target API route path (e.g., `"materials/summary"`, `"materials/thermo"`, `"materials/elasticity"`, `"materials/dielectric"`, `"materials/insertion_electrodes"`)
- `"kwargs"`: Dictionary of URL query parameters

```json
{
  "module": "mp_api",
  "function": "materials/summary",
  "kwargs": {
    "formula": "TiO2",
    "_fields": "material_id,formula_pretty,band_gap,is_stable,energy_above_hull"
  }
}
```

---

## 2. Standard Endpoints and When to Use Them

| Purpose | Endpoint (`function`) | Typical Query Keys in `kwargs` |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| General property search / multi-property lookup | `materials/summary` | `material_ids`, `formula`, `chemsys`, `elements`, `_fields`, `_limit` |
| Detailed thermodynamic stability & convex hull | `materials/thermo` | `material_ids`, `chemsys`, `formula`, `is_stable`, `_fields` |
| Elastic tensors, bulk/shear moduli, Poisson ratio | `materials/elasticity` | `material_ids`, `_fields` |
| Dielectric tensor & refractive index | `materials/dielectric` | `material_ids`, `_fields` |
| Piezoelectric tensors & moduli | `materials/piezoelectric` | `material_ids`, `_fields` |
| Battery electrode voltages & capacities | `materials/insertion_electrodes` | `material_ids`, `elements`, `_fields` |

*Note:* `materials/summary` aggregates properties from all domain endpoints and is the primary endpoint for almost all searches unless deep sub-model details are requested.

---

## 3. Query Parameter Specifications (`kwargs`)

### Essential Parameter Formats
- **`material_ids`**: Comma-separated string of IDs: `"mp-149,mp-2534,mp-804"`
- **`formula`**: Chemical formula string: `"Fe2O3"`
- **`chemsys`**: Hyphen-separated elements: `"Li-Fe-O"`
- **`elements`**: Comma-separated element symbols: `"Li,Fe,O"`
- **`_fields`**: Comma-separated list of response fields: `"material_id,formula_pretty,band_gap"`
- **`_limit`**: Integer limiting number of records returned (e.g., `100`, `10`)

### Formatting Traps & Rules
- ✗ Lists in kwargs: `{"material_ids": ["mp-149", "mp-2534"]}` (URL parameter requires string)
- ✓ Comma-separated string: `{"material_ids": "mp-149,mp-2534"}`
- ✗ Field naming: `{"fields": "band_gap"}`
- ✓ Field naming: `{"_fields": "band_gap,material_id"}`
- ✗ Leaving `_fields` empty when specific attributes are required (returns default fields only)
- ✓ Always include `"material_id"` in `_fields` along with the requested property names.

---

## 4. Worked Retrieval Examples

### Example A: Fetch properties for specific Material IDs
```json
[
  {
    "module": "mp_api",
    "function": "materials/summary",
    "kwargs": {
      "material_ids": "mp-149,mp-2534",
      "_fields": "material_id,formula_pretty,band_gap,energy_above_hull,is_metal,density"
    }
  }
]
```

### Example B: Search stable materials by chemical system
```json
[
  {
    "module": "mp_api",
    "function": "materials/summary",
    "kwargs": {
      "chemsys": "Ga-N",
      "is_stable": true,
      "_fields": "material_id,formula_pretty,band_gap,is_gap_direct,symmetry"
    }
  }
]
```

### Example C: Search battery electrode insertion materials
```json
[
  {
    "module": "mp_api",
    "function": "materials/insertion_electrodes",
    "kwargs": {
      "elements": "Li,Fe,P,O",
      "_fields": "battery_id,material_ids,average_voltage,capacity_grav,capacity_vol"
    }
  }
]
```

### Example D: Query elastic moduli for structural materials
```json
[
  {
    "module": "mp_api",
    "function": "materials/elasticity",
    "kwargs": {
      "material_ids": "mp-149,mp-1000",
      "_fields": "material_id,k_vrh,g_vrh,universal_anisotropy,poisson_ratio"
    }
  }
]
```
